bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: The previous session ended unexpectedly and a checksum drift was detected in the local resource cache. To prevent stale reads and intermittent authentication errors, a cache index rebuild and write‑back flush is recommended. Running the sync will temporarily pause background activity and may reload open tabs or windows. Estimated duration: 30–60 seconds.
